- `public/science/geo/vectorfield/vectorfieldtest` — Package vectorfieldtest is the conformance suite of the vectorfield contract (ADR-0249 SD1): every SourceI implementation runs it against itself.

## Tools

Command and governance packages of this repository's tooling. Their Go API is outside the promise; the `boxer` command tree they build is covered as described in VERSIONING.md.

### app

- `public/app/commands/adr` — Package adr is the `boxer adr` command: it turns the doc/adr corpus — parsed by github.com/stergiotis/boxer/public/gov/adrcorpus — into ClickHouse- queryable Arrow tables, so the state of every ADR can be inspected with SQL via clickhouse-local.
- `public/app/commands/capmap` — Package capmap is the `boxer capmap` command: it reads a business-capability vault and writes it into `boxer.facts` as competence and relation rows (ADR-0168).
- `public/app/commands/capslock` — Package capslock is the CLI wiring for the ADR-0026 §SD10 capslock cross-checker.
- `public/app/commands/compression`
- `public/app/commands/datacatalog` — Package datacatalog is the `boxer datacatalog` command: it discovers what a live ClickHouse instance holds and writes the answers into `boxer.*` as four derived tables (ADR-0170).
- `public/app/commands/datasource`
- `public/app/commands/designsystem` — Package designsystem is the CLI wiring for the IDS toolchain (ADR-0029).
- `public/app/commands/egui2gen` — Package egui2gen exposes the FFFI2 egui2-widget code generator as a boxer subcommand.
- `public/app/commands/errordemo` — Package errordemo is `boxer error demo`: it returns a nested structured error so a person can see how the logger renders one.
- `public/app/commands/fairlead` — Package fairlead is the CLI over the statement journal of ADR-0367 §SD4: it reads what [fairlead.Journal] recorded and says, per exit point, how the statements classify.
- `public/app/commands/findAnchor`
- `public/app/commands/http`
- `public/app/commands/http/serve`
- `public/app/commands/iconsgen` — Package iconsgen exposes the keelson phosphor-icon lookup generator as a boxer subcommand, folding the former standalone iconsgen main into public/app per the entry-point standard.
- `public/app/commands/jackstay` — Package jackstay is the CLI of the guided ClickHouse-to-ClickHouse sync of ADR-0259: one subcommand per step, each reading or writing the plan file (§SD7), all through the engine's workflow functions:
- `public/app/commands/keelsoncodec` — Package keelsoncodec exposes the keelson Go <-> leeway codec generator (ADR-0042) as a boxer subcommand, folding the former standalone keelsoncodec main into public/app per the entry-point standard.
- `public/app/commands/keelsonddl` — Package keelsonddl exposes the keelson facts-store setup DDL — the exact CREATE DATABASE / CREATE TABLE script chstore.SetupTable applies on first run — as a boxer subcommand.
- `public/app/commands/key`
- `public/app/commands/ladingfs` — Package ladingfs is the CLI in front of the lading store's SFTP head (ADR-0198 §SD9).
- `public/app/commands/llm` — Package llm is the host-side command for the model routes (ADR-0383 §SD8): it calls the transcription route directly, as configured by the BOXER_LLM_TRANSCRIBE_* variables, so a deployment can try its route before any app uses it.
- `public/app/commands/markdown` — Package markdown is the CLI in front of the markdown document facts: read Obsidian-flavoured markdown files into `boxer.facts` as document, heading, code-block, link, emphasis, tag and frontmatter rows (the mddocfacts store), or show what would be extracted without a database.
- `public/app/commands/protogen` — Package protogen exposes the protobuf Go generator as a boxer subcommand, folding the former standalone carrierclient/internal/protogen main into public/app per the entry-point standard.
- `public/app/commands/queryrunsd` — Package queryrunsd is the standalone query-run capture service (ADR-0115 S1): it serves the loopback /pull endpoint that the ClickHouse-owned refreshable materialized view reads every cadence, turning terminal system.query_log events into boxer.facts rows of kind QueryRun.
- `public/app/commands/runtimecodegen` — Package runtimecodegen is the CLI wiring for the runtime/factsschema code generator.
- `public/app/commands/sample`
- `public/app/commands/schema` — Package schema is `boxer schema`: the stored boxer tables judged against the columns this build was generated for, and the mechanical part of bringing them in line (ADR-0387).
- `public/app/commands/swisstopo`
- `public/app/commands/sysmetricsd` — Package sysmetricsd is the standalone system-metrics scraper service (ADR-0090 SD2/P3): the sole /proc reader, sampling the host through the sysmetrics collectors and publishing each per-tick BundleSnapshot one-way over NATS for any consumer.
- `public/app/commands/viewerfixture` — Package viewerfixture prepares and checks the media fixtures scripts/ci/viewer_wine_smoke.sh drives the packaged Windows viewer with (ADR-0243).

- `public/gov/adrcorpus` — Package adrcorpus reads the doc/adr corpus into a queryable model: one [Adr] per decision, the [Subtask] sub-items each one declares for itself, and every [CodeRef] citing an ADR number from source.
- `public/gov/adrindex` — Package adrindex generates doc/adr/INDEX.md, a table of every ADR with its number, title, status, date and the ADRs that supersede it.

- `public/gov/capmapanchors` — Package capmapanchors resolves a competence's anchors against the tree (ADR-0337 §SD1) and reads the evidence the tree carries for them (§SD3).

- `public/gov/capmapsimilarity` — Package capmapsimilarity ranks the competences of a vault by how alike their prose is, so a reviewer can find the two notes that describe one thing under two names — the merge candidates a hierarchy written by many hands accumulates — without reading every pair.
- `public/gov/capmapvocab` — Package capmapvocab is the competence corpus's leeway natural-key vocabulary: the memberships that tag a competence or a relation row in `boxer.facts` (ADR-0168 §SD1, §SD2, §SD6).

- `public/gov/commitdigest`
- `public/gov/contracts` — Package contracts collects what boxer promises across a release — the stored, wire and command-line shapes another build or a deployment depends on — as a snapshot, and compares a tree against a committed one (ADR-0388).
- `public/gov/datacatalog` — Package datacatalog answers, as data, what a live ClickHouse instance holds: which tables are leeway-mapped, what leeway schema each one carries, which tables contain one another, and which of the remaining opaque tables a play panel could render (ADR-0170).
- `public/gov/datacatalog/panelshapes` — Package panelshapes is the vocabulary of result contracts a play panel can render, written as RE2 patterns over the data catalog's normalized schema string (ADR-0170 §SD4, §SD5).

- `public/gov/docstd` — Package docstd is the canonical vocabulary for the boxer documentation standard's front-matter contract (DOCUMENTATION_STANDARD §4): the allowed Diátaxis `type:` values, the per-type `status:` lifecycle enums, and a pure validator over a `(type, status)` pair.
- `public/gov/filename`

- `public/gov/licensegate`
- `public/gov/llmtag` — Package llmtag applies //go:build llm_generated_* markers to Go source files whose git-blame attribution points to commits authored with an LLM Co-Authored-By trailer.

## Demos and examples

Illustrative and demonstration code. Outside the promise.

### algebraicarch

- `public/algebraicarch/pushout/pijul` — Package pijul is the domain half of a multi-actor patch-theory event-store demo: four working copies (Server + Alice/Bob/Charlie) backed by a [BackendI] and driven through the [RepoI] interface.

### app

- `public/app/commands/stevedoredemo` — Package stevedoredemo is the `stevedoredemo` command group: the example application of ADR-0252 §SD6, a processor and a lander an operator can run end to end under a streaming framework with the pipeline configuration beside this file.

### apps

- `apps/adhocdemo` — Package adhocdemo dogfoods ad-hoc bundles (ADR-0288, over ADR-0240's datasets): it generates a computed series, publishes it as a bundle — the rows and an applet document that reads them as `items` — through playground.PublishBundle, and shows it through a sqlapplet bundle view, the receiver's one constructor.
- `apps/agentconsole` — Package agentconsole is a coordinator driven by hand (ADR-0269): a window that asks for a task grant over another window and calls that window's operations through the host's runtime.agent services, showing every outcome.
- `apps/capdemo` — Package capdemo is the M2 capability-broker showcase app.
- `apps/hello` — Package hello is the smallest windowed app: one window, one value kept across runs, and a help page.
- `apps/notebookdemo` — Package notebookdemo is a host that embeds a notebook's live reading in a region of its own frame (ADR-0380 §SD5, M4): the first embedder of package notebook's pane.
- `apps/opsdemo` — Package opsdemo is the smallest participant in the app operations contract (ADR-0269): a note and a level, each bound to a widget and each a resource an agent can read and write through the app's catalog while the person edits the same widgets.
- `apps/servicedemo` — Package servicedemo is a headless app — a service (ADR-0352 §SD1) — that does one visible thing: it counts ticks in the background and keeps the count under a persist key, so a reader can see the service host's lifecycle on something: keelson('services') shows it selected and running, its lifecycle rows carry its instance key, and `runtime.persist` holds a count that grows while it runs and survives the process when ClickHouse is up.
- `apps/taskdemo` — Package taskdemo is the ADR-0038 M2 + M4 showcase app.
- `apps/watchbilldemo` — Package watchbilldemo is the first in-tree client of the watchbill protocol (ADR-0234 §M5): one window that enqueues jobs of its own kind through [watchbill.Client], lists the queue with a cancel and a retry on every row, and embeds the task monitor so a running job's progress and its cancel button are the task's.

### science

- `public/science/geo/vectorfield/gribfield/gfsdemo` — Package gfsdemo is one real wind forecast for demos and tests (ADR-0292 SD5): NOAA GFS 10 m wind at 1.0°, 17 steps over 48 hours, committed so that a build that shows it stays offline.

- `public/keelson/designsystem/review/tour` — Package tour implements the Tier 2 SSIM pre-filter for the screenshot tour (ADR-0029 §SD9).
- `public/keelson/designsystem/styletokens/data_encoding`
- `public/keelson/designsystem/web` — Package web serves the IDS lean classless CSS assets (ADR-0076): the hand-authored base + obsidian coverage (ids.css) and the generated colour tokens (ids-palette.css).
- `public/keelson/runtime/agentschema` — Package agentschema is the agent schema (ADR-0313): the relations an agent may read in full, declared once and compiled to SQL twice — to a server principal whose scope is a settings-profile constraint the query cannot override (§SD2), with a restrictive row policy as the backstop that must never fire (§SD3), and to the local worker with the scope as a constant the single writer ships (§SD6).
- `public/keelson/runtime/agentscore` — Package agentscore holds the scorecard of one chat conversation: a single ClickHouse query over the trail views (trailviews) and the run journal's views (journalviews) that answers one row of what the conversation cost, how its tool calls and operations ended, what the person decided, how far its labels rose and whether its artefact was exported, endorsed or refused.
- `public/keelson/runtime/appcenter` — Package appcenter is the app center window (ADR-0260): the registered apps on the left, and one page per app on the right, assembled from the introspection tables that name it — what its windows hold, what it keeps, what it did this run, which jobs, datasets and model calls are its, how much of its code ran, and which ADRs its code cites.
- `public/keelson/runtime/appops/fsmops` — Package fsmops mounts a state machine into an app's operations catalog, so every app that holds one offers an agent the same operations for it.
- `public/keelson/runtime/appops/opengine` — Package opengine is one instance's side of the app operations contract (ADR-0269 §SD4): the queue a command waits in, the per-resource revisions, the snapshot queries read, and the command log.
- `public/keelson/runtime/appops/opfsm` — Package opfsm is the vocabulary a state machine speaks in an app's operations catalog: plain values a machine reports and the operations that [fsmops.Mount] declares return.
- `public/keelson/runtime/appops/opjson` — Package opjson is the model edge of the app operations contract (ADR-0269 §SD10): the JSON a model reads and writes for an operation's arguments and results, and the JSON Schema that describes it.
- `public/keelson/runtime/appops/opwire` — Package opwire is what the host's dispatcher and the window host exchange about operation calls (ADR-0269 §SD3, §SD4): the subject family an operation is addressed on, the phases a call moves through, and the wire forms of a call and its outcome.
- `public/keelson/runtime/appoverride` — Package appoverride lets a deployment restate the descriptive properties of the apps it boots with — their names, summaries, icons, topics, keywords and maturity — by a SQL statement over keelson.apps (ADR-0376).
- `public/keelson/runtime/appstate` — Package appstate is the host side of the app-state manager's delete seam (ADR-0185 §SD3/§SD4): the `runtime.appstate.<op>` request/reply family and the service that answers it over the state store.
- `public/keelson/runtime/attention` — Package attention is the host's account of what the person is shown and what they owe: the levels events are shown at (ADR-0323) and the queue of decisions waiting on the person (ADR-0324).
- `public/keelson/runtime/attention/attentionchrome` — Package attentionchrome draws the person's queue in host chrome (ADR-0324, proposed): a control in the shell's top panel listing what waits on the person, and a non-modal card per opened item.
- `public/keelson/runtime/audit` — Package audit defines the bus audit infrastructure per ADR-0026 §SD12 M2.5.
- `public/keelson/runtime/bgjob` — Package bgjob runs one fast, pure computation as a cancellable background job behind an imzero2 UI.
- `public/keelson/runtime/capture` — Package capture is the host's one way to capture windows for a product path (ADR-0281): a policy enforcement point in front of the renderer.
- `public/keelson/runtime/clipboardbroker` — Package clipboardbroker is the runtime's clipboard Powerbox per ADR-0026 (Update 2026-05-30).
- `public/keelson/runtime/codec/adhocevent` — Package adhocevent is the leeway-coded wire form of the ad-hoc dataset capability's announcements (ADR-0240 §SD8; ADR-0188 §SD3): `adhoc.event.published` on every publish and republish, `adhoc.event.retracted` at the leave step of a withdrawal.
- `public/keelson/runtime/codec/adhocreply` — Package adhocreply is the leeway-coded wire form of the ad-hoc dataset capability's answer to a request (ADR-0240 §SD8), sibling to keelson/runtime/codec/adhocrequest.
- `public/keelson/runtime/codec/adhocrequest` — Package adhocrequest is the leeway-coded wire form of a request to the ad-hoc dataset capability (ADR-0240 §SD8): `adhoc.publish`, `adhoc.resolve` and `adhoc.retract` share one kind under an op symbol, the watchbill shape.
- `public/keelson/runtime/codec/appstatereply` — Package appstatereply is the leeway-coded wire form of the app-state service's answer (ADR-0185 §SD3), sibling to keelson/runtime/codec/appstaterequest.
- `public/keelson/runtime/codec/appstaterequest` — Package appstaterequest is the leeway-coded wire form of an app-state manager request, sent on `runtime.appstate.<op>` (ADR-0185 §SD3).
- `public/keelson/runtime/codec/dialogreply` — Package dialogreply is the leeway-coded wire form of the file-dialog reply payload published on `fs.dialog.{op}` replies.
- `public/keelson/runtime/codec/errkind` — Package errkind is the ADR-0042 M5 retrofit of the rowmarshall.Error hand-coded writer (ADR-0041's parallel-array shredded shape).
- `public/keelson/runtime/codec/errkind/leewayrender` — Package leewayrender bridges a captured errkind.Error into the leeway read pipeline — any streamreadaccess.SinkI, typically the read model (lwread) a leewaywidgets.RecordCard draws.
- `public/keelson/runtime/codec/factswrapper` — Package factswrapper implements marshallgen.WrapperEmitterI for the keelson boxer.facts schema.
- `public/keelson/runtime/codec/inflightsnapshotreply` — Package inflightsnapshotreply is the leeway-coded wire form of the supervisor's list-inflight reply payload.
- `public/keelson/runtime/codec/instanceclosed` — Package instanceclosed is the leeway-coded wire form of the bus's `runtime.instance.closed` announcement (ADR-0240 §SD5): a client that carried an instance key has closed, so whatever the instance owned on a service's books may go.
- `public/keelson/runtime/codec/keelsonqueryreply` — Package keelsonqueryreply is the leeway-coded wire form of the introspection query service's answer (ADR-0253 §SD2), sibling to keelson/runtime/codec/keelsonqueryrequest.
- `public/keelson/runtime/codec/keelsonqueryrequest` — Package keelsonqueryrequest is the leeway-coded wire form of a read over one introspection table, sent on `keelson.query.<table>` (ADR-0253 §SD2).
- `public/keelson/runtime/codec/launchreply` — Package launchreply is the leeway-coded wire form of the app-launch reply payload.
- `public/keelson/runtime/codec/launchrequest` — Package launchrequest is the leeway-coded wire form of the app-launch request payload published on `windowhost.open` (ADR-0135 §SD1).
- `public/keelson/runtime/codec/m1fixture` — Package m1fixture is the ADR-0042 M1 demonstration fact kind: a flat DTO exercising every plain type the generator must support (string, uint{8,16,32,64}, float{32,64}, bool, time, [4]byte, [16]byte) under both `Membership` + `ExactlyOne` and `Membership` + `ZeroToOne` cardinalities.
- `public/keelson/runtime/codec/persistreply` — Package persistreply is the leeway-coded wire form of the runtime.persist reply payload.
- `public/keelson/runtime/codec/taskcancel` — Package taskcancel is the leeway-coded wire form of the cancellation request published on `task.<id>.cancel`.
- `public/keelson/runtime/codec/taskcreated` — Package taskcreated is the leeway-coded wire form of the spawn payload published once per task on `task.<id>.created`.
- `public/keelson/runtime/codec/taskdone` — Package taskdone is the leeway-coded wire form of the terminal-success payload published on `task.<id>.done`.
- `public/keelson/runtime/codec/taskerror` — Package taskerror is the leeway-coded wire form of the terminal-failure payload published on `task.<id>.error`.
- `public/keelson/runtime/codec/taskprogress` — Package taskprogress is the leeway-coded wire form of the periodic progress payload published on `task.<id>.progress`.
- `public/keelson/runtime/codec/watchbillreply` — Package watchbillreply is the leeway-coded wire form of the worker's answer to a watchbill client request (ADR-0234 §SD1), sibling to keelson/runtime/codec/watchbillrequest.
- `public/keelson/runtime/codec/watchbillrequest` — Package watchbillrequest is the leeway-coded wire form of a watchbill client request, published on `watchbill.job.<op>` (ADR-0234 §SD1).
- `public/keelson/runtime/codec/watchevent` — Package watchevent is the leeway-coded wire form of one filesystem-watch event published on `fs.handle.{uuid}.event`.
- `public/keelson/runtime/codec/watchreply` — Package watchreply is the leeway-coded wire form of the watch-reply payload on `fs.handle.{uuid}.watch`.
- `public/keelson/runtime/codec/watchrequest` — Package watchrequest is the leeway-coded wire form of the watch-request payload on `fs.handle.{uuid}.watch`.
- `public/keelson/runtime/configview` — Package configview renders the boxer/public/config/env registry as a read-only inspector.
- `public/keelson/runtime/externaledit` — Package externaledit is the contract by which a window hands a text to an editor in another window and gets every saved revision back.
- `public/keelson/runtime/factsschema/factsread` — Package factsread is how Go code reads the facts table in SQL: a statement is authored against leeway's read surface — column handles and the LW_GET family — and [Prepare] turns it into the statement that executes.
- `public/keelson/runtime/factsschema/storegen` — Package storegen generates a record store bound to the `boxer.facts` table: it hands github.com/stergiotis/boxer/public/storage/recordstore/gen the facts schema and a registry-resolved membership-id snapshot, so the store's baked ids agree with the vocabulary its writers use.
- `public/keelson/runtime/factsstore` — Package factsstore is the durable view of runtime facts per ADR-0026 §SD6.
- `public/keelson/runtime/factsstore/chstore` — Package chstore is the ClickHouse-backed factsstore.FactsStoreI per ADR-0026 M2.5c.
- `public/keelson/runtime/fsbroker` — Package fsbroker is the runtime's file-system Powerbox per ADR-0026 §SD7.
- `public/keelson/runtime/fsbroker/pickerbridge` — Package pickerbridge connects the fs Powerbox service to the egui filepicker widget.
- `public/keelson/runtime/headstore` — Package headstore is the runtime's side of the anchor store (ADR-0314 §SD2; the contract itself is `storage/recordstore/evidence/anchor` since ADR-0327 §SD7): the bus service `runtime.anchor.*` the host answers over an anchor store, its client, the journal's view of a head — a run's ordinal under the journal's scheme — with the head entry that records a receipt, the cadence as data (§SD3), law L32 over a run, and the `keelson('anchors')` relation.
- `public/keelson/runtime/heartbeat` — Package heartbeat emits periodic liveness ticks into FactsStoreI for the current run.
- `public/keelson/runtime/help/docref` — Package docref is the canonical string form of a documentation reference (ADR-0164 §SD5): the one identifier a search hit carries so any surface — a results row, a query result cell, a launch request — can navigate to the section it names.
- `public/keelson/runtime/help/search` — gen_chaliases.go regenerates chaliases.gen.go from the local clickhouse binary's own system.functions — run it via `go generate ./public/keelson/runtime/help/search` after bumping the engine pin.
- `public/keelson/runtime/helphost` — Package helphost is the keelson runtime's inline help reader app.
- `public/keelson/runtime/httpegress` — Package httpegress is HTTP egress as a keelson capability (ADR-0262): the `net.http.fetch.<destination>` request/reply family a hosted app fetches a URL through, the host-wide registry of destinations those subjects name, and the host-side service that holds the transports.
- `public/keelson/runtime/inprocbus` — Package inprocbus is the in-process subject-pattern router that ADR-0026 §SD5 ships in M2 as the pre-NATS transport for app.BusI. NATS-shaped semantics: subjects are dotted token sequences; pattern wildcards match either one token ('*') or all remaining tokens ('>').
- `public/keelson/runtime/inscribe` — Package inscribe is the overlay agents point things out to the person on (ADR-0297): a component of the window host that paints highlights, notes, arrows, numbered steps and spotlights above every window, in one visual language whichever agent asked.
- `public/keelson/runtime/ladingpublish` — Package ladingpublish is the host's write path into the lading store (ADR-0341): an app sends a tree on a bus request under its own mount tag, and the service checks the tree's label against what the store may hold before it writes a snapshot.
- `public/keelson/runtime/launchlimit` — Package launchlimit limits which apps may be opened to those a SQL predicate over keelson.apps selects (ADR-0272).
- `public/keelson/runtime/logbridge` — Package logbridge routes zerolog events into boxer.facts.
- `public/keelson/runtime/loghost` — Package loghost is the in-process start hook that wires boxer's facts-based logging stack into a running CLI host.
- `public/keelson/runtime/logviewer` — Package logviewer is the imzero2 AppI that shows the host's log rows as boxer.facts holds them: counters and the cache's freshness at the top, a filter row below (level / app id substring / message substring / this run or every run), a virtualised table below that, and a collapsible detail pane that opens when the operator clicks a row.
- `public/keelson/runtime/loopback` — Package loopback answers whether a host names this machine's loopback interface — the one predicate behind the loopback-contained surfaces: every Go listener's bind gate ([Gate], ADR-0082 §SD1), the llm service's local endpoint, and httpegress's local destinations (ADR-0262 §SD4).
- `public/keelson/runtime/persist/persiststore` — Package persiststore is the generated record store behind every kind of durable app state (ADR-0105 D3a, and its Update of 2026-08-15 extending D3a to every state-shaped kind).
- `public/keelson/runtime/playground` — Package playground is the runtime's contract for "the playground" — the window another window hands its data to for composition (ADR-0361).
- `public/keelson/runtime/procpool` — Package procpool keeps warm, pre-spawned worker processes for callers that cannot afford a process start per request (ADR-0285).
- `public/keelson/runtime/queryendpoint` — Package queryendpoint lists the SQL query endpoints this OS process serves to its own apps: loopback HTTP interfaces in ClickHouse's dialect, each under the name a document or a menu names it by.
- `public/keelson/runtime/queryrunfacts` — Package queryrunfacts is the pure library of the queryrunsd capture pipeline (ADR-0115 S1): it turns terminal system.query_log events into boxer.facts entities of kind QueryRun.
- `public/keelson/runtime/queryrunsvc` — Package queryrunsvc is the query-run capture service (ADR-0115 S1): a stateless, idempotent, loopback-only HTTP endpoint that a ClickHouse-owned refreshable materialized view pulls.
- `public/keelson/runtime/runinfo` — Package runinfo captures the identity of a single process boot — a "run" — and makes it discoverable to every app launched inside that run via two channels: the BOXER_RUN_ID environment variable, and a zerolog field on the base logger that app loggers derive from.
- `public/keelson/runtime/statestore` — Package statestore is the typed surface of the two state kinds that are not persist values: saved workingsets (ADR-0148) and table column-width overrides (ADR-0151).
- `public/keelson/runtime/task/estimator` — Package estimator is the throughput + humanized-form computation that gates emission inside a task.Handle.
- `public/keelson/runtime/task/supervisor` — Package supervisor is the ADR-0038 M3 audit + heartbeat layer for the task primitive.
- `public/keelson/runtime/topo` — Package topo is the appliance topology vocabulary (ADR-0126): the component-marking contract and the compiled-in component registry.
- `public/keelson/runtime/trail` — Package trail is the host's audit trail on `boxer.facts` (ADR-0277): model calls and their messages, agent actions, grant decisions and egress fetches, each a row composed from shared context components and one domain component — and, for a consumer's own records of processing, the generic [AuditEvent] (ADR-0296), whose vocabulary is values rather than memberships.
- `public/keelson/runtime/trail/trailviews` — Package trailviews composes read-only ClickHouse views over the audit trail on `boxer.facts` (ADR-0277): one flat view per trail kind and a unified timeline across all of them — data marts, row for row — and four aggregates over those: one row per agent action with its outcome, one per conversation, one per agent task, one per audited entity.
- `public/keelson/runtime/trailviewer` — Package trailviewer is the trail viewer (ADR-0350, proposed): a runtime system app that reads the trail marts on boxer.facts by case — a run, a window, an app, a conversation, a task, a data subject, a principal, an entity, an egress destination, or every row — and time window, into a context band and a detail strip over the window (navigation.go), a windowed table, a facets pane and a detail pane with the identity chain, the rows around the selected one, and for an audit event or a grant the previous-state diff.
- `public/keelson/runtime/trailviewer/verdict` — Package verdict is the vocabulary of a writer run's evidence verdict as the trail viewer shows it (ADR-0350 §SD6, proposed): the state, the line of text that names it, the tone it is drawn in and the law it comes from.
- `public/keelson/runtime/vocab` — Package vocab is the runtime's leeway natural-key vocabulary per ADR-0026 §SD6.
- `public/keelson/runtime/watchbill` — Package watchbill is durable work as facts (ADR-0223): a job is a row on a store-owned table, a worker claims it by one conditional update and reads its own mark back (§SD3), every transition is a guarded update followed by an event row (§SD2), a lease is the runtime heartbeat of the run that holds the job (§SD4), and the bus carries an id as a doorbell and nothing else (§SD5).
- `public/keelson/runtime/watchbill/watchbillpresence` — Package watchbillpresence is the facts-bound record store for the watchbill worker's presence (ADR-0237): one `boxer.facts` row per worker run when it starts and one when it stops cleanly, carrying what the run drains — its kinds, its queues, its concurrency — and nothing that changes while it runs.
- `public/keelson/runtime/watchbill/watchbillstore` — Package watchbillstore is the store half of watchbill (ADR-0223 §SD1): two generated record stores on store-owned tables in the house layout — one row per job, updated in place, and one row per transition, appended — plus the claim and sweep statements the worker issues against the job table.
- `public/keelson/runtime/widgethandle` — Package widgethandle provides an opaque, runtime-scoped handle for widget IDs.
- `public/keelson/security/capslock` — Package capslock cross-references google/capslock capability findings against runtime/app manifests per ADR-0026 §SD10.
- `public/keelson/vdd` — Package vdd is the registry of the memberships keelson's fact kinds use: every leeway membership a keelson DTO references is declared here once, with a stable tagged id, a place in a parent hierarchy and a restriction that fixes its cardinality, sub-type and wire encoding.

- `public/semistructured/leeway/canonicaltypes/ctabb` — Package ctabb holds every primitive canonical type as a ready-made Go value, named by its abbreviation: U64 is `u64`, Sh is `sh` (an array of strings), Z64 is `z64`.
- `public/semistructured/leeway/factsschema` — Package factsschema defines the boxer.facts leeway table per ADR-0026 §SD6.
- `public/semistructured/leeway/factsschema/arrowrowcbor` — Package arrowrowcbor is the Phase-0' sparse-CBOR sibling of arrowrowbinary.
- `public/semistructured/leeway/factsschema/cborarrow` — Package cborarrow converts boxer.facts rows from sparse-CBOR (per arrowrowcbor's wire shape) into an ArrowStream IPC payload using the typed Arrow builder generated under factsschema/dml.
- `public/semistructured/leeway/factsschema/codegen` — Package codegen drives the leeway code generators for the runtime facts schema (ADR-0026 M2.5b, plus ADR-0042's Phase-1 pivot).
- `public/semistructured/leeway/factsschema/ddl`
- `public/semistructured/leeway/factsschema/dml`
- `public/semistructured/leeway/factsschema/dml_cbor` — Package dml_cbor is the generated write side of the boxer.facts table targeting the arrowrowcbor backend: the same builders as the factsschema dml package, emitting the sparse, self-describing CBOR rows the bus codec carries instead of Arrow records.
- `public/semistructured/leeway/factsschema/ra` — Package ra is the generated read side of the boxer.facts table: typed readers over the table's plain columns and tagged-value sections (runtime_facts_ra.out.go), and the canonical wire encoder bound to them (runtime_facts_canonwire.out.go).
- `public/semistructured/leeway/readaccess/fatruntime`
- `public/semistructured/markdown/mdgraph` — Package mdgraph turns a corpus of extracted Markdown documents into a document graph: a node per note, per tag and per unresolved link target, an edge per note-to-note link or embed and per note-to-tag use (ADR-0353).
- `public/semistructured/markdown/obsidian`

- `public/semistructured/markdown/obsidian/ext/comment`
- `public/semistructured/markdown/obsidian/ext/embed`

### storage

- `public/storage/recordstore/evidence/anchor/anchorsql` — Package anchorsql is a durable anchor store (ADR-0314 §SD2, by scope since ADR-0327 §SD7): the anchor.StoreI contract over one append-only ClickHouse table, for an organisation that runs its anchor store on a ClickHouse server outside any person's control (ADR-0314, update of 2026-10-13).
- `public/storage/recordstore/evidence/audit/auditrec` — Package auditrec is the recorder of audit events below the keelson runtime (ADR-0330): a sealed, buffered writer over a store a consumer generates with recordstore/gen, reached through a thin adapter ([StoreI], [BatchI]).
- `public/storage/recordstore/pushoutstore` — Package pushoutstore adapts a generated recordstore to the pushout repo.StorageI persistence seam (ADR-0100 S3, ADR-0079, ADR-0221): envelopes, the applied log, the snapshot and the retention ledger persist as append-only rows of one ClickHouse fact table keyed by a string namespace ("env/<hex>", "log", "snapshot", "retention").

### thestack

- `public/thestack/cmd/imzero2tab` — Command imzero2tab is the keelson host for a browser tab (ADR-0263): the Go module a Web Worker runs beside the Rust browser host.
- `public/thestack/cmd/imzero2tabdemo` — Command imzero2tabdemo is the browser-tab binary boxer publishes as a demo on GitHub Pages (ADR-0278 Update 2026-10-04): apps that need no data and no host service, so the published page reaches no third-party endpoint.
- `public/thestack/fffi2/compiletime` — Package compiletime hosts the build-time scaffolding shared by FFFI2 codegen plugins (docgen, goclient, goserver, rustclient).
- `public/thestack/fffi2/compiletime/docgen` — Package docgen emits human-readable reference documentation for FFFI2 IDL definitions.
- `public/thestack/fffi2/compiletime/goserver` — Package goserver generates the Go side that writes the FFFI2 wire format: typed factories, builder methods, procedures and fetchers that marshal their arguments into the stream and read fetcher replies back.
- `public/thestack/fffi2/compiletime/rustclient` — Package rustclient generates Rust-side dispatch tables for FFFI2 IDL definitions.
- `public/thestack/fffi2/ir` — Package ir is the FFFI2 IDL intermediate representation: typed AST for procedures, methods, factories, enums, code-locations, and argument shapes.
- `public/thestack/fffi2/ir/idl` — Package idl is the embedded Go DSL for declaring FFFI2 IDL definitions.
- `public/thestack/fffi2/runtime` — Package runtime is the FFFI2 wire-protocol runtime — binary marshalling, channel I/O, deferred-block capture, and procedure dispatch.
- `public/thestack/fffi2/typed` — Package typed provides Go-side typed wrappers over the raw FFFI2 wire runtime.
- `public/thestack/imzero2/application` — Package application owns the imzero2 process lifecycle: configuration parsing, observability bootstrap, render-loop driver wiring, profiling hooks, and graceful shutdown.
- `public/thestack/imzero2/egui2/colwidth` — Package colwidth resolves table column widths from user-set overrides, per ADR-0151.
- `public/thestack/imzero2/egui2/definition` — Package definition holds the FFFI2 IDL definitions for egui2 widgets, blocks, plots, and helper scaffolding.
- `public/thestack/imzero2/egui2/demo/wasmspike` — Command wasmspike is the Go frame producer of the keelson-wasm-frame-cost trial (ADR-0077 SD2, the Phase-0 spike).
- `public/thestack/imzero2/egui2/driver` — Package driver wires the Rust child-process side of imzero2: spawns the `main_rust` viewport, manages the FFFI2 byte channel, and orchestrates the egui2 codegen build via the embedded compiletime plugins.
- `public/thestack/imzero2/egui2/keycodes` — Package keycodes is the key vocabulary imzero2 widgets capture over the FFI (ADR-0177 SD4, extended by ADR-0279 §SD2).
- `public/thestack/imzero2/egui2/widgets/axisruler` — Package axisruler paints a linear tick axis — a baseline, tick marks, and text labels — along one side of a rectangular plot area.
- `public/thestack/imzero2/egui2/widgets/basemap` — Package basemap resolves the shared slippy-map basemap tile server from the BOXER_MAP_TILE_* environment variables: as a TileSource for the portolan map widget, and as the "basemap" destination of the host's HTTP egress service (ADR-0262), which the widget's tiles are fetched through.
- `public/thestack/imzero2/egui2/widgets/camera` — Package camera is the 2D view transform shared by the painter-lane canvas widgets that pan and zoom over a world of their own: an isotropic scale and a translation, `screen = world · Zoom + Pan`, with the fit, the zoom-about-a-point and the limits that go with it (ADR-0228 §SD5).
- `public/thestack/imzero2/egui2/widgets/codeview` — Package codeview composes the egui2 CodeViewJob primitive with the project's SQL, JSON, and Go highlighters into a small set of retained- holder builders.
- `public/thestack/imzero2/egui2/widgets/color` — Package color provides the unified ImZero2 color type per ADR-0052.
- `public/thestack/imzero2/egui2/widgets/colormap` — Package colormap maps a stream of float32 samples to packed RGBA (0xRRGGBBAA) u32 colors, with NaN/Inf and out-of-range substitution (matplotlib set_bad / set_under / set_over style), intensity scaling (linear, log10, or dB-from-linear-power), and linearly-interpolated palette lookup.
- `public/thestack/imzero2/egui2/widgets/ecdfdigest` — Package ecdfdigest bridges a boxer tdigest.TDigest to the ecdf painter helper (ADR-0267).
- `public/thestack/imzero2/egui2/widgets/gohighlight` — Package gohighlight performs AST-aware syntax highlighting for Go source.
- `public/thestack/imzero2/egui2/widgets/icicle` — Package icicle lays out a hierarchy as an icicle plot: one row per depth, each node a rectangle whose width is its value, children abutting under their parent.
- `public/thestack/imzero2/egui2/widgets/icicle/view` — Package view draws an icicle.Layout as implot custom items (ADR-0160).
- `public/thestack/imzero2/egui2/widgets/imagedecode` — Package imagedecode decodes encoded image bytes into the RGBA8 pixel layout the egui2 image widget consumes: row-major, one uint32 per pixel, packed 0xRRGGBBAA.
- `public/thestack/imzero2/egui2/widgets/inspector` — Package inspector is the shared infrastructure backing the project's "value inspector" widgets — small surfaces that bind to a domain value (FSM state, distribution digest, arbitrary record, error chain) and expose it for human exploration.
- `public/thestack/imzero2/egui2/widgets/jsonhighlight` — Package jsonhighlight tokenizes JSON for syntax highlighting.
- `public/thestack/imzero2/egui2/widgets/layeredgraph` — Package layeredgraph defines the engine-neutral seam for static, layered (hierarchical / Sugiyama) layout of directed flow graphs — state machines, DAGs, the leeway pipeline.
- `public/thestack/imzero2/egui2/widgets/layeredgraph/goccyengine` — Package goccyengine implements layeredgraph.Engine with Graphviz `dot`, run in-process as WebAssembly via goccy/go-graphviz (wazero, cgo-free).
- `public/thestack/imzero2/egui2/widgets/layeredgraph/view` — Package view renders a layeredgraph.Layout into an imzero2 PaintCanvas using the existing painter binding — there is no new IDL/FFI surface (ADR-0069).
- `public/thestack/imzero2/egui2/widgets/lazypane` — Package lazypane gates a host-skippable region — a dock-tab body, or any subtree a parent block can cull — on whether the host actually rendered it last frame, so the Go side can skip building content that would only be discarded.
- `public/thestack/imzero2/egui2/widgets/legend` — Package legend is the painter-lane legend shared by canvas widgets: a boxed list of colour swatch plus label rows, one per item, drawn inside a widget's own canvas and — when the widget wants it interactive — stamped with one sense region per row so a click toggles the row and a hover highlights it.
- `public/thestack/imzero2/egui2/widgets/markdownhighlight` — Package markdownhighlight syntax-highlights markdown source by routing it through goldmark's AST and re-emitting a canonical form, recording the byte offset of every marker as it is written.
- `public/thestack/imzero2/egui2/widgets/pipelineview` — Package pipelineview models and lays out schematic data-processing pipelines: a dominant left-to-right spine of stages (`a | b | c | d`) with side channels leaving each stage at sides fixed by port class — stderr below, configuration above, written artifacts hanging as leaves (ADR-0119).
- `public/thestack/imzero2/egui2/widgets/pipelineview/view` — Package view renders a pipelineview.Layout into an imzero2 PaintCanvas using the existing painter binding — no new IDL/FFI surface, following the layeredgraph precedent (ADR-0069, ADR-0119).
- `public/thestack/imzero2/egui2/widgets/regexhighlight` — Package regexhighlight tokenizes RE2 regular-expression syntax for syntax highlighting (ADR-0015).
- `public/thestack/imzero2/egui2/widgets/sankey` — Package sankey models and lays out flow-quantity diagrams: nodes arranged in stages, joined by ribbons whose thickness is proportional to a conserved value (ADR-0159).
- `public/thestack/imzero2/egui2/widgets/sankey/view` — Package view draws a sankey.Layout as implot custom items (ADR-0159).
- `public/thestack/imzero2/egui2/widgets/scctree` — Package scctree converts `scc --by-file --format json` output into a *layout.Node hierarchy keyed on directory path, suitable for visualization with the treemap widget.
- `public/thestack/imzero2/egui2/widgets/timeline/layout` — Package layout provides the pure-Go layout primitives for the ImZero2 timeline widget: greedy lane packing for interval events, row staggering for annotation flags, multi-resolution bin indexing for point events, and a wrapper over boxer's timeticks for renderer-ready tick coordinates.
- `public/thestack/imzero2/egui2/widgets/timerangepicker` — Package timerangepicker holds the value types and library code for the imzero2 time range picker (ADR-0016).
- `public/thestack/imzero2/egui2/widgets/timerangepicker/evaluator` — Package evaluator runs ClickHouse SQL time-range expressions against a runtime-mediated clickhouse-local worker pool.
- `public/thestack/imzero2/egui2/widgets/timerangepicker/presets` — Package presets provides the time range picker's quick-range sidebar entries.
- `public/thestack/imzero2/egui2/widgets/timerangepicker/validator` — Package validator wraps boxer's nanopass.Parse (ClickHouse Grammar1) to provide sub-millisecond in-process syntax validation for the time range picker's expression fields.
- `public/thestack/imzero2/egui2/widgets/treemap/layout` — Package layout provides a squarified treemap layout algorithm and immediate-mode rendering helpers for the ImZero2 egui2 framework.
- `public/thestack/imzero2/host` — Package imzhost provides reusable imzero2 host-side helpers shared by the carousel demo and elle's cmd host: the shared window chrome (DecorateRenderer / ChromeConfig), the per-app windowed renderer adapter (AdaptToRenderer / WindowDefaultSize), and the screenshot-tour renderers (AdaptBodyOnly / DecorateScreenshotRenderer / ScreenshotStageSize).
- `public/thestack/imzero2/hostaudio` — Package hostaudio joins the two ends of the audio lane inside the Go host (ADR-0372 §SD4): the device that plays an app's sound through a remote viewer, and the application that launched the imzero2 client and holds the pipes to its carrier.
- `public/thestack/imzero2/hostwake` — Package hostwake lets code off the render goroutine ask the imzero2 client for a pass now (ADR-0363 §M4, proposed).
- `public/thestack/imzero2/imzero2env` — Package imzero2env centralises the IMZERO2_* environment variables consumed across the imzero2 demo carousel, tours, and embedded applications.
- `public/thestack/imzero2/metrics` — Package metrics tracks per-frame timing budgets for imzero2 — Go render, Rust interpret, and vsync slack.
- `public/thestack/utfsafe` — Package utfsafe coerces arbitrary byte streams into UTF-8-valid strings for the FFFI wire and other UTF-8-strict consumers.
